title: N-th Tribonacci Number
prompt: The Tribonacci sequence `Tn` is defined as follows: `T0 = 0`, `T1 = 1`, `T2 = 1`, and `Tn+3 = Tn + Tn+1 + Tn+2` for `n >= 0`. Given `n`, return the value of `Tn`.
constraints: The answer is guaranteed to fit within a 32-bit integer, i.e. answer <= 2^31 - 1
hints: This is a straightforward generalization of Fibonacci — each term depends on the three terms before it.
Handle n = 0 and n = 1 as direct base cases before iterating.
Track three rolling variables and slide them forward one step at a time instead of storing the whole sequence.

solution.approach: Tn depends only on the previous three terms, so maintain three rolling variables (a, b, c) initialized to T0, T1, T2. For each step from 3 up to n, compute the next term as their sum and shift the window forward. This computes the answer in linear time using constant space, avoiding both exponential naive recursion and an unnecessary full array.
